`.gitignore` only affects new/untracked files, so those folders stay tracked until removed from Git index. I’ll untrack them safely (keep local files), then show status.

Exactly — `.gitignore` won’t remove files that are already tracked on GitHub.

I’ve already done the fix locally by untracking those folders (without deleting your local files).  
Right now your Git index shows them as staged deletions, which is expected.

Next step to apply on GitHub:

```bash
git commit -m "Stop tracking llm, marimo, and data_analyst"
git push
```

After push, those folders stay on your machine but won’t be tracked anymore.
